conventions.truth: ln(log[:,26]), trailing 8-tick mean, centered finite-difference derivative
conventions.masks: t>1.5 s; outside start..end+0.3 s; plateau abs(rate)<0.2; changing abs(rate)>1; gradient v24>0.002 m/s
conventions.windows: Exact 24-interval estimator _build; actual estimator preprocessed rows and eb; X uses raw measured x without H
conventions.covariance: sigma^2 inverse(R.T M R), surrogate; M evaluated through spectral square root from D4 SVD to preserve its nullspace; rank requires min eigenvalue>24*eps*max eigenvalue; rank-deficient lateral fit c/covariance undefined, axial k_hat=k_only
conventions.lag: Positive lag means signal follows truth; maximize positive Pearson correlation over -25..25 ticks; both endpoints valid
conventions.gain: OLS with intercept; best-lag gain used for implied rate noise and figure normalization
conventions.rate_noise: median abs(v24)*plateau sd(c)/(abs(best-lag gain)*abs(F24)); plateau median primary; all scored median also retained
conventions.harmonic: 24-tick centered OLS: quadratic trend plus joint sin/cos at 15.625 and 20.833333 Hz; median displacement amplitude; sqrt(mean(local force amplitude squared)/2) for force
conventions.contact: Trapezoidal integration of logged contact velocity, without attenuation correction
conventions.added_ripple: Signed rms difference from no-dither case
conventions.L4: All scored ticks primary; plateau/changing differences also retained; nonpositive fits excluded from log and counted
conventions.limitations: One episode per cell, common seed within case, overlapping windows; truth k_eff includes depth/body/velocity dependence; gain/lag are offline
conventions.figure_interval: Display t>=1.5 s, no temporal shift applied; normalization uses offline best-lag gain; nonpositive k_hat gives visible gaps; all ticks saved in NPZ.
